impact: Broad Asian chip buying backs the memory rebound in DRAM, MU and SNXX, though these are midday snapshots and CPI tonight could reverse them.
summary: The Nikkei was up about 2.7% near 60,400 in early afternoon Tuesday as chip and AI names led. SoftBank Group surged more than 11% ahead of its results, Advantest and Tokyo Electron gained about 5% to 6%, and memory maker Kioxia jumped more than 7%.
title: Nikkei reclaims 60,000, SoftBank jumps over 11%, Kioxia up 7%
